starsInstalled: Package “{name}” installed, with {count} stars. Plate solving uses them before the Gaia catalog, even without internet access.
starsUpdated: Package “{name}” updated, with {count} stars. Plate solving uses them before the Gaia catalog, even without internet access.
catalogInstalled: Catalog “{name}” installed: {count} more objects that StarLight recognizes and marks on the image.
catalogUpdated: Catalog “{name}” updated: {count} more objects that StarLight recognizes and marks on the image.
starsDisabled: Package “{name}” disabled. It stays installed, but plate solving uses only the online Gaia catalog.
catalogDisabled: Catalog “{name}” disabled. It stays installed, but its objects are not used.
